questions.question:
Which of the following statements about ServiceNow Strategic Portfolio Management (SPM) is TRUE?

I. SPM integrates Demand Management, Project Management, and Resource Management into a unified platform.
II. SPM replaces all third-party project management tools automatically upon activation.
III. SPM provides visibility into portfolio investments and their alignment with business objectives.
IV. SPM requires separate licensing for each application module.

explanation.correct: SPM integrates Demand Management, Project Management, and Resource Management to provide end-to-end visibility into portfolio investments. It helps organizations align their project portfolios with business objectives. It does not automatically replace third-party tools and is licensed as a unified solution.

wrongAnswers.explanation: SPM does not automatically replace third-party tools, and it is licensed as a unified suite, not separately for each module
Statement II is false - SPM does not automatically replace third-party project management tools
Statements II and IV are false

source.excerpt: The Project Management application not only helps you plan and track projects, it integrates with other applications.
